name: arc_recovered
method: all tensors constructed analytically from scratch; no training/fitting/optimizer or imported learned weights
architecture: minpool1080->180; 17 curvature x9 horizon envelope neurons; ReLU/maxpool; piecewise ReLU heads; maxout and local softmax
envelope_dynamics: nested sweeps with steady-state slip computed from original vehicle equations
limitations: Static visibility of constant-curvature arcs, not a proof of dynamic safety.
Only instantaneous LiDAR: current speed/slip are not observable.
Soft interpolation can still invalidate clearance between discrete arcs.
No claim of global racing-line optimality.
